lessonRef.subject: ready-for-life
lessonRef.title: Supervised application: informational conversations with adults

standardsRefs: Manuel Academy local Ready for Life composition
objective: I can complete a realistic informational conversations with adults task, document the result with minimal private data, and revise a step that does not meet the lesson criteria.
scenario: The learner identifies one adult who could speak knowledgeably about a career or job the learner wants to know more about, this can be a relative, a family friend, a neighbor, a coach, a community member, or anyone a trusted adult helps them contact, then has a short conversation (in person, by phone, or in writing) using prepared questions.
safetyNotes: A trusted adult helps identify and set up contact with the person the learner will talk to; the learner does not contact an unfamiliar adult on their own.
The conversation happens with a trusted adult aware of when and how it is happening (in the room, on a shared call, or reviewing a written exchange).
The learner shares only their first name and general questions about the job; no address, school schedule, or other identifying details are given out.
If the person cannot be reached or the learner does not have someone to ask, use the alternative below instead of contacting an unfamiliar adult to fill the gap.

simulationAlternative.description: If no adult is available for a real conversation, the learner instead reads a provided first-person account of someone describing their job (a short written profile) and writes out answers to the same five prepared questions as if interviewing that person, using only details stated in the profile.

materials: learner-local: a notebook or paper for planning and notes
adult-or-local: a way to reach the adult that a trusted adult has already approved (in person, phone, or writing)

tasks.directions: Analyze the complete worked example on swk-rfl-g10-u01-l04-model-card before beginning.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Complete the fictional coached case on swk-rfl-g10-u01-l04-guided-card, use criterion-specific feedback, and finish its fresh correction turn.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Choose the permitted real-life route or complete fictional route on swk-rfl-g10-u01-l04-independent-card; follow every step and retain only the named minimal evidence.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Complete the minimal evidence record on swk-rfl-g10-u01-l04-evidence-record; omit or fictionalize private details.

prompts.text: After this conversation, are you more curious, less curious, or about the same toward this pathway, and what specifically caused that?

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g10-u01-l04-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g10-u01-l04-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g10-u01-l04-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Question quality: At least three of five questions are specific to this job and could not be answered by a general web search. | Conversation conduct: Learner asked at least three prepared questions and shared only first name and questions. | Synthesis: Summary names a specific, useful piece of information and states whether it changed the learner's interest. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g10-u01-l04-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Have the learner conduct a second informational conversation with someone on a different pathway toward a similar goal (for example, one person who went to trade school and one who learned on the job) and write a short comparison of what each said about entry requirements and day-to-day work.

productionDepth.practicalGoal: I can complete a realistic informational conversations with adults task, document the result with minimal private data, and revise a step that does not meet the lesson criteria.

duration.sessionPattern: 8–10 minutes model and planning, 8–10 minutes guided try, 20–30 minutes application, 7–10 minutes evidence and revision
duration.adultTime: 10–20 minutes for permission, required supervision or review, and physical-event attestation

resources.title: informational conversations with adults worked model
resources.purpose: Shows the starting condition, visible moves, reasoning, and success check before the learner begins.
content: Starting condition: The learner identifies one adult who could speak knowledgeably about a career or job the learner wants to know more about, this can be a relative, a family friend, a neighbor, a coach, a community member, or anyone a trusted adult helps them contact, then has a short conversation (in person, by phone, or in writing) using prepared questions.
Model move 1: Read the condition and name the exact informational conversations with adults decision or action.
Model move 2: Before reaching out, write five questions you genuinely want answered about this job or path.
Model move 3: With your trusted adult, confirm who you will ask and how you will reach them, then have the conversation.

Model check: Question quality: At least three of five questions are specific to this job and could not be answered by a general web search. | Conversation conduct: Learner asked at least three prepared questions and shared only first name and questions. | Synthesis: Summary names a specific, useful piece of information and states whether it changed the learner's interest.

resources.title: informational conversations with adults action steps
resources.purpose: Provides the ordered directions used by the model, guided attempt, independent task, and retry.
content: 1. Read the goal, constraints, and privacy boundary for informational conversations with adults.
2. Analyze the worked model and identify why its sequence meets the criteria.
3. Complete the guided case and use feedback before moving on.
4. Select the permitted real-life route or the complete fictional route.
5. Carry out the task, retaining only the minimum evidence named in the record.
6. Compare the result with the success checks and complete the correction loop when needed.

resources.title: informational conversations with adults coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: The learner identifies one adult who could speak knowledgeably about a career or job the learner wants to know more about, this can be a relative, a family friend, a neighbor, a coach, a community member, or anyone a trusted adult helps them contact, then has a short conversation (in person, by phone, or in writing) using prepared questions.
Coach direction: Before reaching out, write five questions you genuinely want answered about this job or path.
Learner prompt: List your five prepared questions. At least one should ask about something a website would not tell you, such as a hard day at that job or how they got started.
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: informational conversations with adults complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: With your trusted adult, confirm who you will ask and how you will reach them, then have the conversation.
Response 1 (t2-p1): My trusted adult helped me identify and confirm the person I would talk to.
Response 2 (t2-p2): I only shared my first name and my questions, not other personal or identifying details.
Response 3 (t2-p3): I asked at least three of my five prepared questions.

Equal-access rule: If no adult is available for a real conversation, the learner instead reads a provided first-person account of someone describing their job (a short written profile) and writes out answers to the same five prepared questions as if interviewing that person, using only details stated in the profile.

resources.title: informational conversations with adults minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.
Reflection: After this conversation, are you more curious, less curious, or about the same toward this pathway, and what specifically caused that?

Success checks: Question quality: At least three of five questions are specific to this job and could not be answered by a general web search. | Conversation conduct: Learner asked at least three prepared questions and shared only first name and questions. | Synthesis: Summary names a specific, useful piece of information and states whether it changed the learner's interest.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: informational conversations with adults supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g10-u01-l04-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g10-u01-l04-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional informational conversations with adults condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Question quality: At least three of five questions are specific to this job and could not be answered by a general web search. | Conversation conduct: Learner asked at least three prepared questions and shared only first name and questions. | Synthesis: Summary names a specific, useful piece of information and states whether it changed the learner's interest..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g10-u01-l04-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

realRoute.title: informational conversations with adults — permitted real-life route

retry.trigger: Start the correction loop when a required step is missing, the reason does not match the condition, a safety or privacy boundary is crossed, or the evidence does not show the stated result.
retry.targetedReteach: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g10-u01-l04-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step.
retry.supportedReattempt: Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g10-u01-l04-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check.
retry.feedback: Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments.
retry.parallelReattempt: Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g10-u01-l04-retry-pair without the coach prompt.
retry.exitCriterion: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Question quality: At least three of five questions are specific to this job and could not be answered by a general web search. | Conversation conduct: Learner asked at least three prepared questions and shared only first name and questions. | Synthesis: Summary names a specific, useful piece of information and states whether it changed the learner's interest.

guardianInvolvement.role: Give permission; provide only the supervision, handling, review, or observation named in the lesson; attest only that the physical event occurred.
guardianInvolvement.signOffBoundary: A guardian attestation certifies only that the named physical event occurred. It never scores the learner reflection or proves effort, honesty, maturity, responsibility, diagnosis, or character.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.
safety.physicalBoundary: The learner follows the source safety notes and never performs adult-only handling, transport, account, legal, medical, heat, sharp-tool, electrical, chemical, or machine actions.
safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.

privacy.rule: Collect the smallest process record that shows the lesson steps. A learner may choose fictional details and may decline private disclosure without losing credit.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

may: coach the guided and retry cards
mayNot: observe or claim a physical condition
tutorBoundary.physicalCompletionRule: Tutor or AI may coach. Tutor or AI may not certify that a real-world physical action occurred.
tutorBoundary.missingResourceAction: Stop and name the unresolved resource. Do not fabricate it; use another complete delivered route only when every resource for that route resolves.
